Record Class ActivationReport.Cohort

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.analyst.ActivationReport.Cohort
Record Components:
cohort - the month the clients signed up in
registered - how many signed up
orderedWithin30Days - how many placed their first order within 30 days of signing up
orderedWithin30DaysPct - the same as a percentage of the cohort; null for an empty cohort
orderedEver - how many have placed an order at all so far
orderedEverPct - the same as a percentage of the cohort; null for an empty cohort
medianDaysToFirstOrder - median days from sign-up to first order, over the clients who have ordered; null when none have
complete - false while some of the cohort are still inside their first 30 days, so its 30-day figure can still rise and is not yet comparable with older cohorts
Enclosing class:
ActivationReport
public static record ActivationReport.Cohort(YearMonth cohort, long registered, long orderedWithin30Days, BigDecimal orderedWithin30DaysPct, long orderedEver, BigDecimal orderedEverPct, BigDecimal medianDaysToFirstOrder, boolean complete) extends Record
One sign-up month's first orders. A first order is the client's first placed order that executed, filled or rejected, the same as for an active client.
